messages:
Nina: FYI new customer (ShopSwift) wants a tiered "lock" on their catalog entry: low-touch fixes allowed, major architecture changes blocked for 90 days. They also asked for a rollback-credit pool in case we need to revert. Need playbook.
Ethan: Tiered lock makes sense. Define tiers: (A) emergency only, (B) non-breaking patches, (C) full upgrades. Customer wants only A+B during the lock.
Lena: Suggest formalizing rollback-credit: a small pre-funded token budget we can use to backfill traffic on the previous model during rollback without billing surprises. Propose 250k token rollback-credit for 90 days.
Fred: Bench ask: lightweight smoke + regression suite. Propose 1.5k sample suite with quality, latency, and token-cost deltas. Pass if quality delta <=1.2% and p95 latency <= baseline+150ms.
Nina: Canary plan: staged split 1% -> 10% -> 50% across 48h with safety windows. Auto-rollback if quality_regression_rate > 1% or p95 exceed threshold.
Ethan: Ownership: Eng-ML builds bench & verdicts, Product curates prompts and negotiates acceptance, Eng-Platform owns canary automation and rollback-credit accounting, Eng-Infra approves reserved slots.
Lena: Commercials: recommend 10% onboarding credit + we consume rollback-credit first on rollback then bill as used beyond budget. Need SOW language.
eng-platform-bot: INFO: Canary job template exists (canary-template-2). Rollback-credit ledger support flagged as feature request (#FR-442).
Nina: Legal: need a clause that captures tiered-lock semantics, rollback-credit handling, emergency-patch carve-outs, and notice periods. Also confirm audit logging for any rollback actions.
Legal Bot: REMINDER: Include definitions for "non-breaking patch" vs "major upgrade", billing for rollback-credit overage, notice periods (48h for planned, immediate for emergency), and data-residency assurances.
Fred: If bench fails, allow two remediation cycles within 14 days. After that, escalation to product for contract rework.
Ethan: Timeline: bench run by Tue EOD, canary automation validation by Eng-Platform by Thu, legal clause draft in 3 business days, SOW to customer next week.
Nina: I'll assemble the SOW draft and the rollback-credit accounting example. Looping in infra to confirm reserved capacity cost.
Lena: +1. Also store seed prompts immutable and log bench artifacts for future disputes.
Nina: Thanks team — will post updates here.
